access.admin: Must set WEBHOOK_LOGIN_ENABLED=true and hold the WEBHOOK_SECRET value.

rules.requires-opt-in: Plugin is registered only when WEBHOOK_LOGIN_ENABLED=true and WEBHOOK_SECRET is non-empty. Secret alone is insufficient; unset the flag in production except during active debugging.
rules.requires-secret: Authenticated requests must supply the WEBHOOK_SECRET value; invalid or missing secrets return 403.
rules.debug-only: Used for passwordless login in production debugging scenarios; not a regular user sign-in entry point.
rules.cookie-only-session: Establishes a Better Auth session via setSessionCookie. The session token is never returned in the JSON body.
rules.rate-limited: Better Auth customRules throttle /webhook/login to 5 requests per 60 seconds when rate limiting is enabled.
rules.audited: Successful logins write an AuditAction.webhook_login row (no secrets or session tokens in metadata).

fields: Webhook URL handled through Better Auth catch-all
